##### Project general facts

Ohana by the Sea is an exclusive collection of villas by Ohana Development, and its name says everything about the spirit of the place, because Ohana means family in Hawaiian. This is a lavish retreat by the sea where every home is built to measure, offered in two beautiful architectural characters: the Modern villas, which showcase the very latest in contemporary design, and the Mediterranean villas, inspired by the warmth and authenticity of Mediterranean culture. The collection is wonderfully varied, spanning the Makai, Moana and Nohea modern villas, the Kalea and Kaimana Mediterranean villas, elegant canal villas and magnificent seafront mansions, with four, five and six-bedroom layouts to suit every family.

Because no two families are alike, buyers are invited to reimagine the interior layout of their villa, combining or rearranging rooms with expert guidance every step of the way until the vision becomes reality. Life here is centred on the water, with direct access to a private beach, expansive private gardens that can be upgraded to a tropical retreat or a Mediterranean landscape, and gracious private pools. Every home is thoughtfully equipped for effortless living, with its own elevator, generous parking, floor-to-ceiling sliding windows that dissolve the line between inside and out, an impressive double-height entry, and sustainable, innovative VRF air cooling throughout.

The interiors are a celebration of quality, beginning with beautiful European kitchens fitted with integrated premium appliances and further upgrade options for those who love to cook and entertain. Exquisite premium-quality porcelain tiles flow through the living spaces while warm wooden flooring brings comfort to the bedrooms, and the spacious master suites are complete with his and her wardrobes, thoughtfully accessorised inside. Residents can also add their own personal touch by handpicking materials and customising the interior design, choosing between light and dark mood schemes to create a home that is unmistakably theirs.

##### Location description and benefits

Ghantout is a tranquil coastal district nestled between Dubai and Abu Dhabi, offering a perfect blend of natural beauty and modern convenience. Known for its pristine beaches and serene surroundings, it provides an escape from the hustle and bustle of city life while maintaining easy access to urban amenities. Located just a short drive from key landmarks in both emirates, Ghantout is an ideal location for those seeking a peaceful lifestyle without compromising connectivity.

The area is characterized by its luxurious residential communities, including spacious villas and exclusive seaside properties, making it a sought-after destination for families and individuals who value privacy and elegance. Ghantout’s scenic coastline, dotted with palm-lined beaches and turquoise waters, creates a serene backdrop for outdoor activities such as beachside picnics, water sports, and leisurely strolls. The community also features well-maintained infrastructure, ensuring residents enjoy a high standard of living.

Ghantout’s appeal extends beyond its natural beauty, with its close proximity to top-tier leisure destinations, such as world-class resorts, marinas, and golf courses. The area is perfect for those who appreciate a slower-paced, luxurious lifestyle, offering an ideal retreat from the city while still providing access to all the essentials. Whether it’s a weekend getaway or a permanent home, Ghantout captures the essence of coastal living in the UAE.
